context: Done in the record: the purpose now speaks of a list and the selected item's details. The responsive row still says the pane does not collapse on narrow screens, which contradicts "on a phone the details open on their own screen".

current.text: Shows a list and the selected item’s details side by side, so people can move through records without leaving the page; on a phone the details open on their own screen with Back.
The list pane keeps its width and its body scrolls on its own; the detail scrolls beside it. The pane does not collapse by itself on narrow screens.
